Hi Chris,

Structural covariance data using v2 (no individual subject graphs).

I have a similar (but not identical) question to Jonathan Dubois.

I tried the BrainGraph pipeline for standard freesurfer output (e.g. thickness, 2 groups) and it seemed to work well, using my covars and custom atlas files.

Question: Structural covariance data. I have a correlation matrix (all pre-Igraph) in R for a sample consisting of two groups (and my respective covars and atlas files). I would like to plug that correlation matrix into the BrainGraph stream to leverage its possibilities. I looked at the User Guide (v2) but could not find an example on how to proceed.

Could you provide an example of how I would go about this?

Thanks!
-joost

messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] plug correlation matrix (from outside Braingraph) into Braingraph stream

I'm not sure I fully understand. Have you checked out Chapter 5 of the User Guide? Is there a reason you created the correlation matrices outside of igraph/brainGraph?

If you already have correlation matrices, then see section 5.5.2 (pages 27-28) for how to create the graphs. I am not sure how your data are structured, so you may have to change the example code to work.

Chris
